description: Fully window-corrected (complete consistent disconnected-vacuum correction Dconn) HT thermal coefficients C0..C8. corrected = raw + dC, one prescription at every order. dC exact where flagged, otherwise modelled by the delta-v1 ensemble (dC6, dC7 beyond L=44; dC8 beyond L=44).

conventions.log_convention: full: dC4 keeps its +log(L)/17496 and dC5 its ~4.4e-4 log L (no MS subtraction)
conventions.dC_unc: conservative envelope: max(ensemble half-range, |g2D cross-check - central|, max rule-variant shift)
conventions.dC_unc_typ: typical error: max(0.25 * half-range, cross-check, variant shift); validation max |err|/half-range = 0.21
conventions.corrected_unc: equal to dC_unc (raw data are exact to ~1e-14 relative)

raw_sources.C8: raw (lri_c8: L<=50 original package, 52..92 symmetry campaign), L=2..92

note_dC8_beyond_92: dC8 at L=94..118 is modelled for reference only (no raw C8 there); not part of the corrected C8 sequence.
